entry.title: BIP Proposal: ML-KEM Key Establishment
entry.summary:
A recent proposal introduces the concept of Hybrid Key Encapsulation (HKE) within the Elements project, detailed in an ELIP pull request available at [this link](https://github.com/ElementsProject/ELIPs/pull/46). The design leverages a UG combiner function as specified in the CFRG draft found at [draft-irtf-cfrg-hybrid-kems-12](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-irtf-cfrg-hybrid-kems-12/). This function is utilized to integrate two distinct cryptographic paths: the classic secp256k1 Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH) and ML-KEM-768.
By combining these two methods, the construction ensures security against chosen ciphertext attacks (IND-CCA), provided that at least one of the encryption paths remains secure. This hybrid approach enhances the overall robustness of the key encapsulation mechanism, offering a practical solution for post-quantum readiness while maintaining backward compatibility with established cryptographic standards.
